## About
Dalco Air Conditioning and Heating is a family owned business on Military Parkway in Dallas. Founder and President Ken Oringderff and our team work with homeowners and businesses across North Central Texas to keep their heating and cooling running right.
We install new systems and handle repairs and maintenance for residential, commercial and industrial customers. Our goal is simple: keep you cool in the summer and warm in the winter.
Have a question about your system? Call, come by the shop or send us a message. We are rated 4.3 on Google from 43 reviews.

## Services
- Installation, repair and maintenance: New heating and cooling system installs, repairs and maintenance for residential, commercial and industrial customers.
- Basic plan: Spring and fall maintenance covering the thermostat, filter, electrical connections, refrigerant charge, safety controls, condenser coils, heat exchanger, burners and more. ($139.90)
- Premium plan: Everything in the basic plan, plus condenser coil cleaning with a cleaning agent, condensate drain line cleaning with nitrogen and an anti-algae treatment. ($242.90)
- Germ protection and duct cleaning: Year round anti-germ options including germicidal lights, disinfecting fogging and duct cleaning.

## FAQ
Q: What do comfort plan members get?
A: Automatic on-time maintenance scheduling, priority scheduling of service calls and a 15% discount on all repairs.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Our Google listing shows us open 24 hours, every day of the week.

Q: Can I finance a new system?
A: Yes, you can apply online to finance a new Lennox system.
